label: Simple priority is well-founded, from grounding well-founded on actual concreta (inference)
rule: Transfer well-foundedness along a predecessor inclusion (wellFounded_of_predecessorInclusion)
meaning: Non-transcription conditional derivation on one m and w, for the shared frame's simple-priority field F.PriorSimply (sense PRIOR_1). If grounding among actual concreta at w is well-founded (82cfaf26), whatever is simply prior to something other than itself is an actual concrete ground of it at w (86efed1a) and nothing is prior to itself (32d77f18), then simple priority is well-founded on the whole carrier (d85de8e1). Step: what is prior to x is other than x by irreflexivity, hence an actual concretum grounding x; well-foundedness transfers. Superseded assessment (docs/notes/one-dependence-order.md, section 'Sense splits'): the bound type is PRIOR_1, which DEF 1d9aa4d9 defines as priority in act in a respect, so it is not an unsplit relation with two readings; on that sense 86efed1a meets the hand-and-stick counterexample (reading the selected grounds existentially, and the hand as PRIOR_1 to the stick in the respect of moving; causal-dependence-support-investigation.md (e), row 1), and its positive warrant (priority in being) belongs to PRIOR_4, a separate sense since #1751. 86efed1a's own paraphrase records a second falsifier: a non-concrete or absent simply prior thing. The split is tested in specs/dependence-order-senses.toml: on PRIOR_4 (priority in being, already a sense) a weaker bridge among actual concreta carries well-founded grounding to PRIOR_4 among actual concreta, while this PRIOR_1 derivation keeps the counterexample to 86efed1a and its only consumer (e229bb2c) needs PRIOR_1. The existing chain from d85de8e1 to the secunda via premise 97f5850f (e229bb2c to 42890b45, then 438866fa with f10d5632) also needs the all-respects premise e078f07b, whose joint use with respect-free d85de8e1 is lane A's reciprocity case (row 21) and against which the hand-and-stick counterexample is kept; so this argument does not by itself carry well-founded grounding to the secunda via. The closed controls priorityControls give, for each input, a Bool interpretation in which the other two hold and priority is not well-founded (the irreflexivity omission is a self-loop, which the distinct-relata bridge does not see), and a nonvacuous interpretation.
